title: Local spanning implies integral root power map extensionality
statement: For a family of sections G whose values locally span every coefficient tensor power, two morphisms out of a fixed positive tensor power that agree on all displayed G sections are equal.

source.place: section-tensor-product, sheaf separatedness and linear span argument (Tags 03EK and 03EL)

proof.text: Apply sheaf and presheaf hom extensionality. For a section z, take the covering sieve on which its restriction lies in the span supplied by local generation.
Use target sheaf separatedness to compare restrictions and induct on Submodule.span. Zero, addition and scalar cases follow from linearity; the generator case is exactly the assumed equality on G.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing generic APIs match this argument; no root-specific extensionality theorem was found.

theorem integralRootPower_hom_ext_of_locallySpans
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (G : ∀ (d : ℕ) (V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (_a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj V),
      (Fin d → (purTwistZlOne T l).obj.obj V) →
        (coefficientTwistPower T (R := (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T))
          (purTwistIntegralModule T l E) d).val.obj V)
    (hgen : IntegralRootPowerLocallySpans l E T G)
    (d : ℕ) (N : proEtaleRingModules T (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T))
    (f g : coefficientTwistPower T (R := (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T))
      (purTwistIntegralModule T l E) d ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ V a x, f.val.app V (G d V a x) = g.val.app V (G d V a x)) :
    f = g
